title: cytisus hirsutus var. subleiocarpus
intro: Cytisus hirsutus var. subleiocarpus, commonly known as a variety of the hairy broom, is a plant species belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system regulation. The bioactive constituents of Cytisus hirsutus var. subleiocarpus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
